title: Comment for 12 CFR 1026.43 — Minimum Standards for Transactions Secured by a Dwelling
excerpt: Rental income may be considered for repayment ability, but income relied upon must be verified using reasonably reliable third-party records. Verification records must be specific to the individual consumer; records of average incomes in the consumer’s location are insufficient. Unidentified account inflows cannot be counted as income without confirmation.
metadata_status: current regulatory interpretation accessed

title: Freddie Mac Single-Family Seller/Servicer Guide, Section 5306.1 — Rental income
jurisdiction: United States; Freddie Mac eligible loans
excerpt: For subject 1-to-4-unit investment property, the guide requires a current fully executed lease and documented receipt of rental payments or security deposit plus first month’s rent in specified cases. A property purchased on or up to 45 days before note date that is not yet rented may document market rent using Form 72.
metadata_status: current guide version identified as effective 2026-04-12

title: Fannie Mae Selling Guide B3-3.6-05 — Income or Loss Reported on IRS Form 1040, Schedule E
jurisdiction: United States; Fannie Mae eligible loans
excerpt: For rental income reported on Schedule E, regular and ongoing expenses—including maintenance, advertising, management fees, utilities, association dues, and supplies—should be subtracted from borrower cash flow; mortgage payment treatment must avoid double counting.
metadata_status: current guide page accessed; page identifies base section date 2014-09-30

title: Submit documents and answer requests from the lender

excerpt: The joint agencies announced AVM quality-control standards for models used to value homes in certain mortgage transactions: high confidence in estimates, protection from data manipulation, conflict controls, random sample testing/reviews, and nondiscrimination compliance.

A lease must be supported by the form or specified evidence that payments or deposits occurred.

The authors caution that results may be specific to the AVM and geographies analyzed.

title: Rental Income
